leadText:
The Black 2 & White 2 arc (Japanese: ブラック２・ホワイト２編 Black 2 & White 2 arc), also referred to as The 11th Chapter (Japanese: 第十一章 The Eleventh Chapter), is the eleventh story arc of the Pokémon Adventures . It began serialization in July 2013, and ended in April 2020.

This arc follows the adventures of , a member of the International Police seeking to arrest the Seven Sages of Team Plasma, and , a former hiding under a civilian guise in Aspertia City. Unknowing of each other's true colors, both of them end up attending the same class at the Aspertia Trainers' School. At the same time, Team Plasma, led by Colress, is planning to exact an ice-cold revenge on the entire Unova region for their defeat at the end of the .
